newsitem.title: USA: Vivid Tech gets $3.4 mln order from France.
newsitem.headline: Vivid Tech gets $3.4 mln order from France.

text.p: Vivid Technologies Inc, a maker of bomb detection devices, said Tuesday it has received additional orders worth $3.4 million from French airport authorities.
Vivid said France's Service Technique des Bases Aeriennes made the fresh orders after the company completed tests head-to-head with other competing companies.

The additional orders are for 10 systems for use at the Paris' Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports, regional airports in Nice and Lyon and in French departments at Saity-Denies de la Reunion and Cayene in Guiana.
La Reunion is an island east of Madagascar in the Indian Ocean and Guiana is located north of Brazil on the northeastern coast of South America.
Vivid said its systems have been selected for use in 23 major airports in 12 countries.
